card.name: Start of a drug name after a comma
card.fires_on: The first piece of a drug name that is split into several parts, such as A in AJOVY or AUSTEDO, a in aripiprazole, or me in meperidine. It also fires on a word just before a drug name.

modes.label: Brand name start
modes.description: The opening letters of an all-caps brand name.

modes.label: Generic name start
modes.description: The opening piece of a generic drug name after a list comma or 'oral'.

modes.label: Word before a drug name
modes.description: A general word or 'to' placed right before the drug is named.
modes.example: hypersensitivity<< to>> faricimab or any of the

card.writes: It seems to push toward the rest of a drug name that starts with an unusual piece, rather than ordinary words.
card.plain: It fires when a drug name is just beginning and the model is about to spell out the rest of it.
